name: shutupandlisten-promptfoo
description: promptfoo evaluation harness for the shutupandlisten prompts

scripts.eval: if [ -f ../.env.local ]; then promptfoo eval --env-file ../.env.local; else ../scripts/eval-keys.sh npx promptfoo eval; fi
scripts.eval:smoke: if [ -f ../.env.local ]; then promptfoo eval --env-file ../.env.local --filter-pattern career-decision --filter-providers openai --filter-prompts claude; else ../scripts/eval-keys.sh npx promptfoo eval --filter-pattern career-decision --filter-providers openai --filter-prompts claude; fi
